shortDescription: RRB Group D / Level-1 Syllabus – Mathematics, Reasoning, General Science and General Awareness for CBT.
content:
RRB/RRC Level-1 (Group D) selection starts with a Computer Based Test.

CBT subjects (indicative)

  • Mathematics
  • General Intelligence and Reasoning
  • General Science
  • General Awareness / Current Affairs

Usually 100 questions, 90 minutes, negative marking as per CEN. Questions are generally of Class 10 standard for Maths/Science.

Topic outline

  • Maths: Number system, BODMAS, Decimals, Fractions, LCM-HCF, Ratio, Percentage, Mensuration, Time & Work, Time & Distance, SI-CI, Profit-Loss, Algebra, Geometry, Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics
  • Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical/Number Series, Coding-Decoding, Mathematical operations, Relationships, Syllogism, Jumbling, Venn, Data Interpretation, Conclusions, Decision making, Classification
  • General Science: Physics, Chemistry, Life Sciences of Class 10 level
  • GA: Current affairs, Science & Tech, Culture, Sports, History, Geography, Economic scene, General Polity, Indian Constitution

PET standards (male/female) are in the official CEN. Source: RRB regional / rrbapply.gov.in.
